parameters.query: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.role, u.password_hash, u.client_id, u.is_active, c.company_name, c.api_key, c.plan_type FROM users u LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = u.client_id WHERE u.email = '{{ $json.email }}' AND u.is_active = true LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO user_sessions (email, session_token, role, client_id, expires_at, is_active) VALUES ('{{ $json.email }}', '{{ $json.token }}', '{{ $json.role }}', {{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}, NOW() + INTERVAL '8 hours', true); UPDATE users SET last_login_at = NOW() WHERE email = '{{ $json.email }}'; SELECT log_audit({{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}, 'auth-login', 'user_login', 'auth', {{ $json.user_id }}, '{"email": "{{ $json.email }}", "role": "{{ $json.role }}"}'::jsonb, 'success')

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, email: $json.email, name: $json.name, role: $json.role, company: $json.company, plan: $json.plan, api_key: $json.api_key, token: $json.token }) }}
